facts.value: The host oracle compiles complete pinned rate, utilization, accrued-index and supplied/debt getter function bodies, inheriting unchanged Core, Math, Storage and Configuration. Only override modifiers and holder mapping reads are substituted; rates and signed principal are explicit inputs.
facts.note: The generated harness, exact selectors, storage layout, all source hashes and as-run Rust generator hash are recorded under conformance/fixtures/comet-oracle. No constructor or deployed runtime is executed.

facts.value: 1,515 model comparisons cover rates, packed stored utilization, both projected indices, supplied balance, debt and inherited conversions; two additional ABI controls reject invalid widths. Explicit failures cover uint40 time, backward clock, both indices, int104 extremes and safe casts.

facts.note: Six boundary and 32 deterministic generated markets use explicit values, three clocks and five signed principals. The shared bounded interpreter adds TIMESTAMP, SIGNEXTEND and SGT with direct controls. No saved chain interval or initialized observed-holder coverage is claimed.
